messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's authz incident. TL;DR token validation cache in edge-proxy didn't invalidate on revocation -> short window where revoked tokens were accepted. I published a short postmortem and action items. Please ack ownership for tasks you pick.

sanjay: saw it, thanks. can you paste the action list here so i can assign in the board?

maya: Sure — short list: 
- A1: fix cache invalidation in edge-proxy (owner: sanjay, due: 2026-03-30)
- A2: backfill audit events for 2026-03-22 02:14-02:22 (owner: olivia, due: 2026-03-28)
- A3: rotate signing keys + publish runbook (owner: kevin, due: 2026-04-01)
- A4: add synthetic CI test covering token revocation and cache miss (owner: jordan, due: 2026-03-27)

olivia: Ack. I'll start the backfill tomorrow morning. I need read-only access to raw logs on s3 (bucket: redwood-auth-raw).

kevin: Ack. I'll draft a key rotation plan. question: do we rotate HSM-protected keys or just KMS-wrapped keys for now? leaning KMS-only unless compliance asks for HSM.

jordan: On the CI test — i can add a nightly job that hits revocation paths, but need a stable dev token generator to flip revoked vs valid quickly. @maya can you share the snippet?

maya: pasted below:
```bash
# dev token generator for CI
python tools/dev_token_gen.py --sub=ci-test --exp=5m --revoke-after=30s
```

ops-bot: Incident postmortem published: https://redwood.company/pm/incident-2026-03-22 (links to board, timeline, and raw logs index)

sanjay: quick note: this mirrors a jan incident where edge cache invalidation missed the update because of the load-balancer draining delay. we should add a short recurring check for cache-control headers and an alert if revocation events don't propagate within 30s.

kevin: agreed. propose monthly "perm-drift" audit + dashboard alert when audit events coverage <95% across services. i'll add an infra ticket to bake the metric.

olivia: timeline question: can A2 (backfill) and A4 (ci test) land before our next deploy window Fri 2026-03-27? I can expedite logs access if owners confirm.

jordan: I can get A4 in by Thu 2026-03-26, will need token generator and a small harness.

sanjay: aiming for A1 by Mon 2026-03-30 but can push a hotfix earlier if we see another regression. putting a tentative calendar block.

maya: thanks all — i've added these tasks to the postmortem board, labeled security/remediation and priority/high, and linked owners. Ping me on thread if blocked.

kevin: i'll add the rotation runbook to infra/docs and cc compliance on the timeline.

olivia: ack :+1:

jordan: ack

sanjay: ack
